name: FlhA/FlhB/FliPQR export gate
description: The five jointly required proteins of the flagellar type III secretion export gate.

name: FliI/FliH export ATPase complex
description: The export ATPase and its regulatory partner, jointly required.

name: FliE/FlgBCFG rod
description: The proximal and distal rod proteins together with the rod-MS ring junction, jointly required.

name: FliG/FliM/FliN switch complex
description: The three jointly required switch proteins.

name: FlgK/FlgL junction
description: Both hook-associated proteins are jointly required.

name: flagellin filament with FliD cap
description: Flagellin and the distal cap, jointly required.

name: MotA/MotB stator unit family
description: The MotAB stator family, which includes the proton-driven MotAB units of Escherichia coli and the sodium-driven PomAB units of Vibrio. KEGG assigns both to K02556/K02557, so this system evidences a stator without evidencing its coupling ion; see inst/doc/proposal-structural-gifts.md.

name: FlgH/FlgI L and P rings
description: Both envelope bushings are jointly required.

name: PilB extension ATPase
description: The PilB-type assembly ATPase of Pseudomonas and Myxococcus systems.

name: PilF extension ATPase
description: The PilF-type assembly ATPase of Neisseria and Thermus systems; a non-interchangeable orthologue serving the same function.

name: PilM/N/O/P alignment subcomplex
description: All four proteins are jointly required to span the envelope.

name: PilT retraction ATPase
description: PilT. The paralogue PilU is not accepted here: it cannot retract a pilus on its own, so it is not evidence of the retraction function.
